description.value:
You unleash a searing wave of fire in a 15-foot cone from your position. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 fire damage on a failure or half that on a success.

Unattended flammable materials caught in the cone catch fire.

Overcharge Tech. Cast with a 2nd-level slot or higher, this power's damage increases by 1d6 for every slot level beyond 1st.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 1
